comparison_policy.full_vs_career_only: Includes both H/F and E/A effects; must not attribute every change to history
comparison_policy.isolated_history_effect: Full ranking compared with C/G/R/E/A only; same normalization and tie-breaks
comparison_policy.career_plus_history_vs_career_only: C/G/R/H/F compared with C/G/R; omits E/A on both sides

performance.scope: Plain Python computation, preloaded mappings, no dataset I/O or network in timers
